-- Declared by the ref's ContainerFrame.lua / PetActionBarFrame.lua / WorldStateFrame.lua -- (files we don't ship); the manage pass below overwrites them every run. CONTAINER_OFFSET_X = 0 CONTAINER_OFFSET_Y = 70 BATTLEFIELD_TAB_OFFSET_Y = 210 PETACTIONBAR_YPOS = 97 -- ref PetActionBarFrame.lua:3. Not a managed row (the manage pass computes only the Y); -- the custom block at the end of the pass recomputes it, for the reason recorded there. PETACTIONBAR_XPOS = 36
-- ref UIParent.lua:2 — the model panes' held-button spin rate (half a turn per second), -- read by every `Model_OnUpdate` transcription (the character window's + inspect's). ROTATIONS_PER_SECOND = .5
UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS = {} -- Frames UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["MultiBarBottomLeft"] = {baseY = 17, reputation = 9, maxLevel = -5, anchorTo = "ActionButton1", point = "BOTTOMLEFT", rpoint = "TOPLEFT"} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["GroupLootFrame1"] = {baseY = 60, bottomEither = 42, pet = 42, reputation = 9} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["TutorialFrameParent"] = {baseY = 55, bottomEither = 47, pet = 42, reputation = 9} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["FramerateLabel"] = {baseY = 64, bottomEither = 42, pet = 42, reputation = 9} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["CastingBarFrame"] = {baseY = 60, bottomEither = 40, pet = 40, reputation = 9} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["ChatFrame1"] = {baseY = 85, bottomLeft = 17, pet = 17, reputation = 9, maxLevel = -5, anchorTo = "UIParent", point = "BOTTOMLEFT", rpoint = "BOTTOMLEFT", xOffset = 32} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["ChatFrame2"] = {baseY = 85, bottomRight = 17, rightLeft = -88, rightRight = -43, reputation = 9, maxLevel = -5, anchorTo = "UIParent", point = "BOTTOMRIGHT", rpoint = "BOTTOMRIGHT", xOffset = -32} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["ShapeshiftBarFrame"] = {baseY = 0, bottomLeft = 45, reputation = 9, maxLevel = -5, anchorTo = "MainMenuBar", point = "BOTTOMLEFT", rpoint = "TOPLEFT", xOffset = 30}
-- Vars UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["CONTAINER_OFFSET_X"] = {baseX = 0, rightLeft = 90, rightRight = 45, isVar = "xAxis"} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["CONTAINER_OFFSET_Y"] = {baseY = 70, bottomEither = 27, bottomRight = 0, reputation = 9, isVar = "yAxis", pet = 23} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["BATTLEFIELD_TAB_OFFSET_Y"] = {baseY = 210, bottomRight = 40, reputation = 9, isVar = "yAxis"} UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS["PETACTIONBAR_YPOS"] = {baseY = 97, bottomLeft = 43, reputation = 9, maxLevel = -5, isVar = "yAxis"}
function UIParent_ManageFramePositions() -- Frames that affect offsets in y axis local yOffsetFrames = {} -- Frames that affect offsets in x axis local xOffsetFrames = {}
-- Set up flags. Departure: the bottom flags read the always-on bars' visibility, -- not the ref's SHOW_MULTI_ACTIONBAR_1/2 option globals (0270 ships no such state). local bottomLeftShown = BenillaMultiBarBottomLeft and BenillaMultiBarBottomLeft:IsShown() local bottomRightShown = BenillaMultiBarBottomRight and BenillaMultiBarBottomRight:IsShown() if ( bottomLeftShown or bottomRightShown ) then table.insert(yOffsetFrames, "bottomEither") end if ( bottomRightShown ) then table.insert(yOffsetFrames, "bottomRight") end if ( bottomLeftShown ) then table.insert(yOffsetFrames, "bottomLeft") end
if ( MultiBarLeft and MultiBarLeft:IsShown() ) then table.insert(xOffsetFrames, "rightLeft") elseif ( MultiBarRight and MultiBarRight:IsShown() ) then table.insert(xOffsetFrames, "rightRight") end
if ( ( BenillaPetActionBarFrame and BenillaPetActionBarFrame:IsShown() ) or ( BenillaShapeshiftBarFrame and BenillaShapeshiftBarFrame:IsShown() ) ) then table.insert(yOffsetFrames, "pet") end if ( ReputationWatchBar and MainMenuExpBar and ReputationWatchBar:IsShown() and MainMenuExpBar:IsShown() ) then table.insert(yOffsetFrames, "reputation") end if ( MainMenuBarMaxLevelBar and MainMenuBarMaxLevelBar:IsShown() ) then table.insert(yOffsetFrames, "maxLevel") end
-- Iterate through frames and set anchors according to the flags set local frame, xOffset, yOffset, anchorTo, point, rpoint for index, value in pairs(UIPARENT_MANAGED_FRAME_POSITIONS) do frame = getglobal(index) if ( frame ) then -- Always start with base as the base offset or default to zero if no "none" specified xOffset = 0 if ( value["baseX"] ) then xOffset = value["baseX"] elseif ( value["xOffset"] ) then xOffset = value["xOffset"] end yOffset = 0 if ( value["baseY"] ) then yOffset = value["baseY"] end
-- Iterate through frames that affect y offsets local hasBottomLeft, hasPetBar, hasBottomRight for flag, flagValue in pairs(yOffsetFrames) do if ( value[flagValue] ) then if ( flagValue == "bottomLeft" ) then hasBottomLeft = 1 elseif ( flagValue == "pet" ) then hasPetBar = 1 elseif ( flagValue == "bottomRight" ) then hasBottomRight = 1 end yOffset = yOffset + value[flagValue] end end
if ( hasBottomLeft and hasPetBar ) then yOffset = yOffset + 23 end
-- Iterate through frames that affect x offsets for flag, flagValue in pairs(xOffsetFrames) do if ( value[flagValue] ) then xOffset = xOffset + value[flagValue] end end
-- Set up anchoring info anchorTo = value["anchorTo"] point = value["point"] rpoint = value["rpoint"] if ( not anchorTo ) then anchorTo = "UIParent" end if ( not point ) then point = "BOTTOM" end if ( not rpoint ) then rpoint = "BOTTOM" end
-- Anchor frame if ( value["isVar"] ) then if ( value["isVar"] == "xAxis" ) then _G[index] = xOffset else _G[index] = yOffset end else frame:SetPoint(point, anchorTo, rpoint, xOffset, yOffset) end end end
-- Custom positioning the row table cannot express (ref l.1705-1738). Both rules -- belong to the pet/stance ROW — the one row two different bars share — and without -- them the pet bar lands on top of the bottom-left multibar's buttons -- (director-caught: the bar drew across a row of spells, border and all). -- -- (a) The shelf art IS the pet bar's border, and it only makes sense when the bar -- sits directly on the main bar. Raised a row it would draw across whatever is -- underneath, so the ref hides both strips (l.1707-1708) — the same move it makes -- for the stance bar's own end-caps, which is why benilla's stance bar has none -- (0270 anchors it statically at the raised position). -- (b) The pet bar is the only managed entry whose row is a VAR: the loop above writes -- the NUMBER PETACTIONBAR_YPOS (97, +43 with the bottom-left bar up) and anchors -- nothing, so the ref re-seats the frame with it here (l.1735-1736). -- -- Departure: the ref computes PETACTIONBAR_XPOS in ShowPetActionBar() and reads it -- here, which only works because its bar slides in over several frames. Ours appears -- at once, so the value is computed where it is used. Same rule -- (PetActionBarFrame.lua:170-174): the two bars share this row, so a pet bar shown -- while the stance bar is up starts 20px past the last stance button. That case is -- rare but real — a possessed or charmed unit gives a pet bar to a class that also -- has forms. local bottomLeftUp = BenillaMultiBarBottomLeft and BenillaMultiBarBottomLeft:IsShown() if ( BenillaSlidingActionBarTexture0 and BenillaSlidingActionBarTexture1 ) then if ( bottomLeftUp ) then BenillaSlidingActionBarTexture0:Hide() BenillaSlidingActionBarTexture1:Hide() else BenillaSlidingActionBarTexture0:Show() BenillaSlidingActionBarTexture1:Show() end end if ( BenillaPetActionBarFrame ) then PETACTIONBAR_XPOS = 36 local forms = GetNumShapeshiftForms and GetNumShapeshiftForms() or 0 if ( forms > 0 and BenillaShapeshiftBarFrame and BenillaShapeshiftBarFrame:IsShown() ) then local last = getglobal("BenillaShapeshiftButton"..forms) local right = last and last:GetRight() if ( right ) then PETACTIONBAR_XPOS = right + 20 end end -- The ref guards this on IsShown() because a hidden bar of its is mid-slide and -- owns its own anchor; ours has no slide, so re-seating a hidden frame is a -- no-op and the guard would only add an ordering trap (OnShow fires the pass). BenillaPetActionBarFrame:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "BenillaActionBar", "BOTTOMLEFT", PETACTIONBAR_XPOS, PETACTIONBAR_YPOS) end
-- The under-minimap right stack (ref l.1740-1770): anchorY walks down capture bars → -- quest timer → durability → quest watch, each shown frame pushing the next one down -- by its own height. benilla ships the durability + quest-watch arms (below); the two -- feeders above them (capture bars, quest timer) don't exist yet, so anchorY starts at -- the ref's initial 0. The reference never leaves DurabilityFrame on its static XML -- anchor (whose +40 hangs the side glyphs off-screen — director-caught): every pass -- seats it at -CONTAINER_OFFSET_X, minus 20 more when a showSeparate glyph -- (shield/off-weapon/ranged) extends the art to the right — then drops the quest -- tracker to the running anchorY so the two never collide at the same corner. local anchorY = 0 if ( DurabilityFrame ) then local durabilityOffset = 0 if ( DurabilityShield:IsShown() or DurabilityOffWeapon:IsShown() or DurabilityRanged:IsShown() ) then durabilityOffset = 20 end DurabilityFrame:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "MinimapCluster", "BOTTOMRIGHT", -CONTAINER_OFFSET_X-durabilityOffset, anchorY) if ( DurabilityFrame:IsShown() ) then anchorY = anchorY - DurabilityFrame:GetHeight() end end -- QuestWatchFrame is last in the ref's walk (l.1770), seated at the running anchorY so -- it drops below the durability guy when he shows instead of overlapping him (both -- anchor this same MinimapCluster corner — director-caught). benilla's tracker is -- BenillaQuestWatchFrame; nil-guarded because the durability-only test harness (and -- any config without a quest log) ships no such frame. if ( BenillaQuestWatchFrame ) then BenillaQuestWatchFrame:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "MinimapCluster", "BOTTOMRIGHT", -CONTAINER_OFFSET_X, anchorY) end end
